name: Micro Tank Battle
author: Addicting Games
description: Tank Battle is a free action game where your objective is to destroy the other tank! This mobile game doesn’t give you a chance to breathe. Right away you need to come out shooting and using the environment to your advantage. As soon as the game starts, you’re suddenly in an enclosed space with only crates to hide behind. You have a limited amount of bullets that you can see in the upper tabs. You can find bullets, missiles, and other weapons through the crates as you’re fighting. Click on the trophy icon to drop down the leaderboards and see where you stand in this online cute shooter game. Don’t like playing alone? Invite your friend over to play against each other and see who has the most wins!
